definitions.explanation: The physical eyeball. Also used in the expression {目玉|めだま}が{飛|と}び{出|で}る (eyes pop out) to express extreme surprise or shock at a price.
The most attractive or attention-grabbing item or feature, especially in sales, events, or plans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目玉焼|めだまや}き→目玉焼き：14946_medamayaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧{目玉|めだま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{出|で}た。
examples.english: My eyes popped out when I saw the price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{目玉|めだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くりくり⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}ていた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The child was looking on curiously with big, round eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目玉|めだま}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧だ。
examples.english: The featured item in the sale is a TV.
What is the highlight of this project?

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目玉|めだま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{拡充|かくじゅう}だ。
examples.english: The centerpiece of this budget proposal is a major expansion of childcare support.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1: ⟦{目玉焼|めだまや}き→目玉焼き：14946_medamayaki⟧ (fried egg, literally "eyeball fry") is a very common compound. The expression {目玉|めだま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{出|で}る (⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧) means the price is shockingly high.

Sense 2: Used as a modifier, {目玉|めだま}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (featured product) is standard retail language.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目玉焼|めだまや}き→目玉焼き：14946_medamayaki⟧: fried egg (sunny-side up)
- {目玉|めだま}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: featured product, loss leader
- {目玉|めだま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{出|で}る: eyes pop out (from shock)
- {目玉|めだま}⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧: featured project/event
